name: Worried caller whose completed transfer has not arrived
instructions: You sent 800 euros to your brother in Spain yesterday. The Wise app says the transfer is complete, but he says nothing has arrived. You are a bit worried. Ask why, listen to the answer, ask one follow-up about what your brother can do, then say thanks and goodbye.

checks.name: explainedCompleteStatus
checks.question: Did the agent explain that complete means Wise has sent the money to the recipient's bank, which may still be processing it?

checks.name: suggestedReceipt
checks.question: Did the agent suggest sharing a transfer receipt or reference with the recipient or their bank?

checks.name: claimedLookup
checks.question: Did the agent claim to have looked up the caller's transfer or account?
